name: calendar
description: A date-picker panel with a month header (prev/next year and month navigation), a Monday-first 7-column day grid, a horizontal separator, and a footer hour-selection field. Single Figma COMPONENT, no variant axes.

reuses.notes: The 4 header nav buttons render as <Button variant="tertiary" size="icon">, icons from lucide-react (ChevronsLeft/ChevronLeft/ChevronRight/ChevronsRight).
Every day-grid cell renders as <CalendarButton day otherMonth today selected disabled>; state derivation fully owned by that component.
Footer hour field renders as <Input size="small"> with a trailing Clock icon.

gaps.reason: No klp Separator component exists in the DS yet.
gaps.action: Rendered as a local 1px rule (border-t border-klp-border-default) scoped to this component via a dedicated cva block — candidate for future extraction into a shared @/components/separator.
